turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm making soup for my grandmother, she's just had her teeth out.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh, poor her. Something smooth and gentle then. Would she prefer a sweet carrot and ginger, or something more savory like a leek and potato?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, I need a minute with my roommate. Just stay silent until I come back to you.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you come back early today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So Leo's football is at ten on Saturday, and Mia's swimming is at half ten. On opposite sides of town.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you do football and I'll take Mia?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I did football last week. And it was freezing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'll do football, you do swimming, and you owe me a coffee.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Deal. Then we all meet for lunch after?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If Leo's not covered in mud, sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm back, sorry for the wait.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. About your grandmother's soup. Sweet carrot or savory leek?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Carrot, but go easy on the ginger.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, just a small piece then. Cook the carrots until very soft so it blends silky.
